headings: AARON LEVINE X ZARA WOOL-LINEN SUIT
rendered_description:
Description
Suit crafted from a wool and linen blend fabric (excluding linings).
Regular fit blazer. Notch lapels and long sleeves finished with buttoned cuffs. Half-lined interior. Features a welt chest pocket and flap hip pockets. Interior pocket detail. Back vent. Front button closure.
Regular fit trousers. Front pockets and back double-welt pockets with button. Front zip fly and hidden metal hook fastening.
Aaron Levine x ZARA special collection.
